io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request

Class FunctionChainOp

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.FunctionChainOp

  • public class FunctionChainOp
extends Object
    A single operation in a FunctionChain pipeline. Mirrors PyMilvus's FunctionChainOp. The op name is a server-recognized operation name; the Milvus proto lists e.g. "map", "filter", "sort", "limit", and "merge". The static map/sort/limit factories set a valid op; the raw builder only requires a non-empty string so future server ops remain expressible.
